Australian Pacer Takes 8 Wickets as Bangladesh Collapses in Warm-up

In a cricket warm-up match preceding a Test series against Australia, Bangladesh was bowled out for 54 runs. An Australian pacer, aged 22, took eight wickets for 25 runs. The match was a preparation for Bangladesh's upcoming Test series against Australia, which features prominent bowlers like Mitchell Starc, Pat Cummins, and Josh Hazlewood. Mitchell Starc is also noted to be nearing a milestone previously held by Kapil Dev.
